2608.14106.title: Forecast Collapse in Time-Series Foundation Models
2608.14106.paper_summary: When forecasting hourly returns for 1,000 US equities, we observe an unexpected phenomenon: predictions become nearly flat and show poor stock ranking, as measured by cross-sectional correlation. We call this forecast collapse. Surprisingly, the phenomenon largely disappears when forecasting trading volume under the same setting. We investigate forecast collapse across time-series foundation models (TSFMs), twelve deep-learning forecasting models, and 97 public benchmark configurations, and find that it is closely tied to target predictability. We identify two distinct reasons behind it: low predictability limits the amplitude of calibrated point forecasts, while per-series objectives leave cross-series structure unidentified. These findings reveal a calibration-ranking tradeoff: optimizing squared error leads to flat predictions, whereas directly optimizing cross-sectional correlation improves ranking but can inflate forecast amplitude by more than an order of magnitude. To address this tradeoff, we introduce CalibRank, a simple objective that balances calibration and ranking. On Finance1K, CalibRank nearly triples cross-sectional correlation while keeping amplitude close to the target, and improves correlation on all tested models. Our results reveal a blind spot in conventional time-series evaluation: per-series metrics can hide failures in cross-series structure needed by downstream decisions.
2608.14106.paper_summary_zh: 當預測1,000支美國股票的每小時回報時，我們觀察到一個意想不到的現象：預測變得幾乎平坦，且顯示出較差的股票排名，這是通過橫斷面相關性來衡量的。我們稱這種現象為預測崩潰。令人驚訝的是，當在相同設定下預測交易量時，這一現象在很大程度上消失了。我們研究了時間序列基礎模型（TSFMs）、十二個深度學習預測模型和97個公共基準配置中的預測崩潰，發現它與目標可預測性密切相關。我們確定了兩個明確的原因：低可預測性限制了校準點預測的幅度，而每系列的目標則使得跨系列結構無法識別。這些發現揭示了一種校準-排名的權衡：優化平方誤差導致平坦的預測，而直接優化橫斷面相關性則改善排名，但可能會使預測幅度膨脹超過一個數量級。為了解決這一權衡，我們引入了CalibRank，一個簡單的目標，平衡了校準和排名。在Finance1K上，CalibRank幾乎使橫斷面相關性增加了三倍，同時保持幅度接近目標，並改善了所有測試模型的相關性。我們的結果揭示了傳統時間序列評估中的盲點：每系列的指標可能隱藏了下游決策所需的跨系列結構中的失敗。
